trans-unit.source: Specialist electrical engineering for industrial automation
Dongua Engineering Solutions provides electrical design expertise for industrial automation projects, with particular experience in control panels, MCCs and the UK water industry.
Practical engineering built around real project delivery

Dongua Engineering Solutions S.L. is a specialist engineering company focused on electrical design for industrial automation. Our work is centred on producing clear, buildable and maintainable electrical designs that integrate effectively within wider engineering projects.

The company brings experience from electrical engineering projects in the UK water and wastewater sector, including control panel and MCC design, motor control, electrical schematics and supporting technical documentation.
We work with system integrators, panel builders and engineering contractors that require specialist electrical engineering support or additional design capacity for their projects.
Electrical design experience shaped by industrial projects
Experience developed through electrical engineering work for industrial automation projects, particularly within the UK water and wastewater sector.
Electrical design experience supporting automation projects across the UK water industry.
Design experience covering control panels, motor control centres, motor starters, variable speed drives and associated control systems.
Structured electrical schematics, panel layouts and engineering documentation developed for manufacture, testing and project delivery.
Engineering focused on practical project delivery
Our approach is based on clear communication, structured engineering documentation and electrical designs developed with manufacture, testing, installation and maintainability in mind.
Dongua Engineering works as an extension of the wider project team, adapting to client standards, engineering requirements and established project workflows.
Electrical Engineering background supported by formal university education and practical industrial project experience.
Electrical design and documentation developed using professional engineering tools including Bentley Promis.e and AutoCAD.
Professional Indemnity and Public Liability insurance maintained for engineering activities.
